items.headline: O: GPT-5.6-Cyber expansion via Daybreak tiers
items.summary: O is rolling out a more cyber-permissive GPT-5.6 Sol variant (GPT-5.6-Cyber) through Daybreak tiered access for vetted defenders, with reported capability/response-rate differences versus less-guardrailed access.

items.headline: O: Astra release slowed over potential critical cyber risk
items.summary: O told Axios it “cannot rule out” Astra having critical cyber capabilities, prompting expanded safety testing and slowed development until stricter controls are in place; release timing could shift.
